description: Header file defining the HdmiCec class and related data structures for HDMI CEC management, including device info, event handling, and JSONRPC interface.

classes.name: CECDeviceInfo
classes.description: Represents HDMI CEC device information including logical address, vendor ID, OSD name, and status flags.

classes.name: HdmiCec
classes.description: Main class managing HDMI CEC devices, events, and JSONRPC interface, inheriting from PluginHost interfaces, FrameListener, and MessageProcessor.

methods.name: setEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to enable or disable CEC functionality based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getEnabledWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to retrieve current CEC enable status.

methods.name: getCECAddressesWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to get current CEC device addresses.

methods.name: sendMessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper method to send a CEC message.

methods.name: getDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected CEC devices.

methods.name: getActiveSourceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of the active source.
